name: morph-island
title: Morph Island
description: A compact panel for a timer, an export and an incoming call.
useCases: In an incoming-call prototype, a user accepts or declines a call. The app receives the decision through onCall.
In a mobile UI presentation, a designer cycles through the built-in activities to show a timer and operation progress in one compact panel.
task: A compact panel for a timer, an export and an incoming call.
behavior: title labels the call. onCall receives a boolean indicating acceptance or dismissal.
